name: stream-inbox-classifier
label: Classify conversations
description: One agent reads each given Stream Inbox conversation and proposes its tag; the main agent keeps the tag tree small. Answers one proposal — conversation x tag plus the tag tree changes. Writes nothing.

exe_data.prompt: Classify the conversations your input names (ids in `conversations`, or the window `since` / `until`) with the stream-inbox-classifier skill, and answer with the checked value.
